revision-thirteen-flash.kind: Agent inspection of exact exported records and source excerpts; not qualified human scientific auditing

cases.assessment: Useful guided reading route; incomplete scientific core
cases.strengths: Wave propagation and diffraction, resolution limit, mask exposure, resist chemistry, scanner imaging. Limits are distinguished from applications.
cases.limitations: Layout-to-mask and downstream pattern transfer are peripheral; etching is not performed by the scanner. The reading route contains teaching links and is not a historical reconstruction.

cases.assessment: Main application path present, but one logical arrow is invalid
cases.strengths: Electrical discharge and plasma creation connect to PECVD; energy conversion is added without rewriting retained claims.
cases.limitations: r8 treats the CVD deposition step as sufficient premise for PECVD. The model check incorrectly approves this even while acknowledging a component relationship. Electron-ionization mass-spectrometry evidence and atmospheric plasma examples do not establish the reactor-specific links; these links were withheld.

cases.assessment: Representative narrow recovery and reuse route
cases.strengths: Conserved momentum, expelled reaction mass, retropropulsive landing, vertical recovery and repeated use are connected.
cases.limitations: No detailed guidance, throttling, thermal protection, inspection or reflight certification. No primary-source priority reconstruction. Propellant reserve percentage is scoped to the source, not all vehicles.

cases.assessment: Usable partial CUDA explanation; foundation and architecture coverage remain shallow
cases.strengths: Independent work, scalar kernel, thread indices, memory and GPU acceleration have inspectable links.
cases.limitations: PTX is isolated. Some evidence describes Tesla/Fermi/Kepler-era hardware and particular bioinformatics workloads. General current-generation GPU claims require better primary evidence.

cases.assessment: Incomplete explanatory route; not a quality pass
cases.strengths: Sequence/structure and sequence covariation are present with inspected sources.
cases.limitations: The endpoint is AlphaFold 2, but a retained side branch discusses AlphaFold 3 and AlphaFold 1. The invalid direct AF3-to-AF2 connection is withheld. The core coordinate-generation step is missing. A later read-only probe retrieved the original AlphaFold 2 full text successfully, but this run did not receive it; probe evidence must not retroactively count as evidence in this map.

cases.assessment: Representative language-model learning and generation explanation, not complete ChatGPT internals
cases.strengths: Probability, neural representations, next-token training, attention and dialogue generation are connected.
cases.limitations: Teaching relationships are substantial. The map does not establish proprietary contemporary ChatGPT architecture, training recipe or a full documented history.

revision-twelve.kind: Qualitative inspection by a software agent; not a qualified human scientific audit

cases.coverage: Introductory optical pattern transfer: wave behavior, mask imaging, resist chemistry and a wavelength-dependent resolution limit. The new aperture/diffraction insight adds useful nuance.
cases.limits: Does not reconstruct a complete EUV scanner. Two supporting insights remain disconnected. The main explanation is useful as orientation, not an engineering specification or verified historical lineage.
cases.readiness: Usable exploratory orientation, with visible gaps

revision-sixteen.kind: Agent inspection of actual claims, warrants, assumptions and sources. Not a qualified human scientific audit.

cases.assessment: Useful partial optical-lithography map; not a strict core pass
cases.strengths: Wave optics, mask projection, diffraction-limited resolution, development and machine operation are inspectable.
cases.limitations: Projection and reduced-image projection overlap. Resist/EUV boundaries are weakly connected. The route mixes teaching, application and bounds; it is not a historical reconstruction.

cases.assessment: Representative explanatory PECVD core
cases.strengths: Activation-energy and energy-transfer foundations connect to electron dissociation, reactive radicals, surface deposition and excitation control. Seven insights and seven connections.
cases.limitations: Arrhenius-style root assumes classical kinetics, not every reaction pathway. The supporting low-temperature radical passage is from graphene PECVD; the inspector explicitly states that material scope. Quantitative reactor and surface-kinetics details remain gaps.

cases.assessment: Representative recovery explanation with Newtonian foundations
cases.strengths: Newton third law and momentum conservation connect to reaction thrust, retrograde burns, controlled descent, aerodynamic surfaces and recoverable stages.
cases.limitations: Guidance is only a broad operational requirement; no specific control algorithm or refurbishment/certification method is established. Economic advantage is a side branch rather than a scientific necessity.

cases.assessment: Connected CUDA explanation; hardware-era qualifications remain necessary
cases.strengths: Per-thread kernels, blocks/grids, memory spaces, coalescing, divergence and host-device transfer limits form an inspectable graph. The missing data-parallel foundation is added under a new identity and checked.
cases.limitations: Much technical evidence describes older CUDA/GPU implementations. Independent thread scheduling, unified memory and modern programming models are not fully represented; no claim of complete current-generation coverage is justified. Some teaching links are reciprocal, not temporal history.

cases.assessment: Primary-source architecture recovered, deeper foundation still missing
cases.strengths: The original AlphaFold 2 paper now supports MSA representation, Evoformer graph inference, the 3D structure module and iterative training. Seven insights and nine inspectable relationships.
cases.limitations: No accepted general foundation survived the check; the coevolution and sequence-to-structure additions remain specialized bridges. The Evoformer-to-structure-module mechanism is incompletely connected. This fails the foundational-route target despite substantial architectural improvement.

cases.assessment: Representative language-model learning and assistant route
cases.strengths: Conditional probability and neural representation learning connect to language modeling, pretraining, assistant fine-tuning and ChatGPT. Seven insights and six connections.
cases.limitations: Text prediction and assistant behavior are explained at an introductory level. The endpoint mentions multimodal outputs, but their separate architectures and proprietary current implementations are not established by this graph. No universal model-generation or full historical claim is justified.

revision-seventeen.kind: Agent inspection of actual generated claims, warrants and retained source passages. Not qualified human scientific auditing.

cases.assessment: Representative optical-lithography explanation with a foundational route
cases.strengths: Wave interference and ray optics lead into photoresist response, reticle projection, step-and-scan exposure, immersion and diffraction/depth-of-focus constraints. Eight insights and eight relationships; no duplicate projection additions.
cases.limitations: This is a generic projection/DUV process map, not a complete EUV machine architecture. Resist development belongs to the surrounding fabrication workflow, not necessarily the exposure machine itself. Named-machine control, precision metrology, priority and quantified process windows remain unestablished.

cases.assessment: Representative PECVD mechanism with connected general chemistry and plasma ideas
cases.strengths: Electric discharge and radical reactivity connect to electron acceleration, precursor dissociation, surface reaction, ion bombardment and film deposition. Seven insights and ten relationships; every retained insight participates in the graph.
cases.limitations: Several links are explicitly authored teaching aids. Radical reactivity is general; ion-bombardment evidence is specific to carbon/oxide films. No universal low-temperature limit, complete plasma kinetics, reactor recipe or historical priority is established.

cases.assessment: Representative reusable-stage route grounded in Newtonian mechanics
cases.strengths: Newton third law and conservation of momentum connect to reaction thrust, retrograde burns, soft landing and repeated use. Six insights and seven relationships; all insights connected. Two mismatched limiting arrows were correctly withheld.
cases.limitations: No detailed guidance/control architecture, thermal-protection chain, inspection or reflight certification is established. An orbital-launch first stage follows a suborbital recovery trajectory. Priority and the first operational reuse are not independently established.

cases.assessment: Connected GPU/CUDA execution explanation with a general parallelism foundation
cases.strengths: Independent work, throughput-oriented processors, kernels, block/grid organization, warps and memory management lead to CUDA execution. Eight insights and eight relationships. The known conflicting SIMT reference was withheld.
cases.limitations: Much evidence describes earlier CUDA/hardware generations. Many-core operation is an enabling architecture rather than a universal law. Current independent scheduling, unified memory and the programming model are incomplete. Host/device transfer is a visible side branch lacking a retained connection; no specific speedup is established.

cases.assessment: Representative AlphaFold2 architecture and evolutionary-data route, with a separate physical-folding gap
cases.strengths: Evolutionary covariation, structural/sequence databases, MSA and pair embeddings, Evoformer updates, coordinate output and local AMBER refinement form an inspectable route. The original AlphaFold2 paper is among the three retained sources. Ten insights and ten connections; nine insights participate.
cases.limitations: The hydrophobic-effect foundation remains disconnected from the learned algorithm: no arrow was invented to imply that AlphaFold simulates global folding. Thermodynamic scope and the sequence-determined-fold premise need qualification. Training losses, detailed coordinate generation, disordered proteins and later AlphaFold generations are not comprehensively established.

cases.assessment: Representative statistical-learning to conversational-language-model route
cases.strengths: Statistical estimation, conditional sequence prediction, attention, positional information, GPT pretraining and conversational fine-tuning form a seven-insight, seven-relationship map. All insights are connected. A component-as-deduction error was withheld; a separately checked teaching link supplies the foundation.
cases.limitations: The architectural explanation is about text language models and early documented ChatGPT fine-tuning. The endpoint mentions speech and images, whose separate implementations are not established by this route. Token prediction is often simplified as word prediction in the sources. Proprietary current model details, historical influence and comprehensive alignment mechanisms remain gaps.

revision-fourteen-alphafold.kind: Agent inspection, not human scientific review
revision-fourteen-alphafold.assessment: Completed in 140.4 seconds but foundational coverage remains weak: central dogma describes the input sequence but not why it encodes structure. Attention is generic; the original AlphaFold 2 architecture is absent. Broad accuracy and topology statements require generation-specific primary evidence. This is not a scientific quality pass.

revision-thirteen-glm.kind: Agent inspection, not qualified human scientific audit

cases.assessment: Representative PECVD mechanism path; still an exploratory secondary-source explanation
cases.strengths: Electrical breakdown, non-equilibrium electrons, precursor dissociation and radical film growth form a continuous route. Sheath bombardment and hydrogen incorporation are separate mechanisms/limits.
cases.limitations: Thermal and material scope require primary engineering evidence. Broad statements about plasma nitride hydrogen content must not be extended to every modern process.

cases.assessment: Failed timing and scientific-quality acceptance
cases.strengths: Kernels, indexed threads and memory use are present.
cases.limitations: 188.7 seconds; weak foundational route; unrelated application added. r8 reverses the intended bound and r9 incorrectly derives a measured 24x speedup from broad architecture statements. Positive model review did not catch these defects. Original output and receipts are preserved.

revision-fourteen-pecvd.kind: Agent inspection, not human scientific review
revision-fourteen-pecvd.assessment: A representative source-linked explanation with electric-field and chemical-bond foundations, discharge, excitation control, inductive coupling and substrate reaction. Seven insights and nine arrows; no component-as-deduction arrow retained. Primary priority and quantitative surface chemistry remain gaps.
